result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions that could never match, in `codeanalyzer`. The new regression test and the related existing tests pass. Nothing is committed.

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`**
  - The pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules were `(html|html|xhtml)`. They are now `(htm|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match.
  - The JavaScript `// Generated by` rule was `.*/[.]js`, and the .NET `<doc>` XML rule was `.*/[.]xml`. Both required a directory separator before the dot, so they only matched a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**: the Gradle rule was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, which only matched a file literally named `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`.
- **New test `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsMatchTest.java`**: 4 tests covering the fixed `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases. It also checks that the existing `.html`/`.xhtml` cases, `build.gradle`, and hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still stay out of those scopes.

Tests run offline: `DefaultConventionsMatchTest` (4/4), plus `SourceFileFilterTest`, `CodeConfigurationTest` and `SourceFileTest`, all passing.
